title: NILS MCP door
description: Wave 4c section 6.7 (D11, C43): what a third party MCP client gets from the engine's /mcp door. The vocabulary is sixteen operations; a pack opts each in as a tool by name with its own description and rules (packs/<name>/mcp.yml), and the tool's input schema is the operation's, verbatim. Every result is the envelope below; a rows answer pages by offset; the policy of each operation is the policy row of the door it calls (contracts/suite capabilities.schema.json, policy_row).

result.description: The envelope of every tools/call answer: the document as text a model reads, the same document structured when it fits the result cap, and whether it is a refusal. A domain refusal is text a model can act on, never a transport error.

paging.description: A rows answer: the handle's page, from offset, bounded to the door's page size; while rows remain the document carries next_offset, and the next call passes it as offset

policy.description: The policy fields a client may show beside a tool: the row of the door the operation calls

cost.description: free: one read; bounded: a read capped by the door; job: queued for a worker, answered with an id; stream: held open
